name: Utsumuki Shoujo ~Minna Matomete Yaminasai~
original_name: うつむき少女 ～みんなまとめて病みなさい～
source:
The new semester starts today.
Though I like wearing long-sleeved sweaters, I don't like going to school nor talking to people.

Even so, there's a small... just a tiny chance that I could enjoy school if...

"Hey."

...if he were there...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/4792]Freem![/url]]
translation:
新学期从今天开始。
虽然我喜欢穿长袖毛衣，但我不喜欢上学，也不喜欢与人交谈。

即便如此，我还是有很小的……很小的机会能够享受学校生活，如果……

“嘿。”

……如果他在的话……

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/4792]Freem![/url]]
